files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.AcknowledgementCommandException
files.Summary: Represents an exception that is thrown when an acknowledgement command fails due to an underlying error.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.Client
files.Summary: Represents a reusable AMQP client that manages an underlying connection and provides access to message broker producers, consumers and subscribers. The client is safe for concurrent use and supports asynchronous startup and disposal.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ConsumerExtensions
files.Summary: Runtime helpers for extracting capability-specific interfaces from a generic instance. These helpers avoid breaking changes while providing explicit runtime checks for acknowledgement/transactional features.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ConsumerOptions
files.Summary: Options for configuring a message consumer of a queue.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ConsumerTransformerAsync
files.Summary: A delegate that a client can register that will be called each time a consumer dispatches a message to the client code to allow the client to Transform a received message from one type to another, StreamMessage to TextMessage, ObjectMessage to TextMessage containing XML, etc. This allows a client to create a consumer that will automatically transform a message to a type that the client is capable of processing or adding additional information to a received message. For messages that do not need to be processed the client should return null from this method, in this case the original message will be dispatched to the client.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.DefaultRedeliveryPolicy
files.Summary: Represents the default redelivery policy used to determine message redelivery behavior.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.IAcknowledgeConsumer
files.Summary: Represents a consumer that supports explicit acknowledge and negative acknowledge operations (e.g. ClientAcknowledge or IndividualAcknowledge modes).

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.IClient
files.Summary: Represents a client that manages AMQP connection lifecycle and related producer/consumer/subscriber managers.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.IConsumer
files.Summary: Broker-backed message receiver exposing core, transport-agnostic operations for consuming messages and managing destinations.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.IConsumerManager
files.Summary: Manager abstraction responsible for creating and managing instances. Implementations provide asynchronous creation methods with various configuration options and support deletion/lifecycle management of created consumers.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.IProducer
files.Summary: Defines the contract for a message producer that creates and sends messages to queues or topics in a messaging system. Provides asynchronous methods for message creation, sending, and transaction management. Implementations are expected to be safe for concurrent use and to honor cancellation semantics where applicable.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.IProducerManager
files.Summary: Factory abstraction responsible for creating and managing instances. Implementations create producers for destinations or queues and support deletion and lifecycle observation. All creation methods are asynchronous to allow for remote or I/O-bound producer initialization.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ISubscriber
files.Summary: Broker-backed message receiver exposing core, transport-agnostic operations for consuming messages and managing destinations.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ISubscriberManager
files.Summary: Manager abstraction responsible for creating and managing instances. Implementations provide asynchronous creation methods with various configuration options and support deletion/lifecycle management of created subscribers.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ITransactionalConsumer
files.Summary: Represents a consumer that supports transactional commands (Commit/Rollback).

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.MessageAction
files.Summary: Defines the actions that can be taken for a message processed by the consumer.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.MessageQueueEventArgs
files.Summary: Provides data for events raised when a message is queued, processed or otherwise observed by the consumer pipeline.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.NmsAmqpClientOptions
files.Summary: Represents the configuration options for the NMS AMQP client, including connection string and redelivery policy.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.OnErrorHandlerAsync
files.Summary: Delegate invoked when an error occurs while processing messages.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.OnMessageReceivedHandlerAsync
files.Summary: Delegate invoked when a message is received from the message queue.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ProducerOptions
files.Summary: Options used to configure a message producer.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ProducerTransformerAsync
files.Summary: A delegate that a client can register that will be called each time a Producer's send method is called to allow the client to Transform a sent message from one type to another, StreamMessage to TextMessage, ObjectMessage to TextMessage containing XML, etc. This allows a client to create a producer that will automatically transform a message to a type that some receiving client is capable of processing or adding additional information to a sent message such as additional message headers, etc. For messages that do not need to be processed the client should return null from this method, in this case the original message will be sent.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.RedeliveryPolicy
files.Summary: A policy used to customize exactly how you want the redelivery to work.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ResponderOptions
files.Summary: Configuration options that control where and how a responder sends reply messages. These options allow specifying an explicit , or alternatively a destination name and type to be used when creating the response destination.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ResponseDestinationType
files.Summary: Specifies the type of destination to which a response message is sent.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.SendResponseException
files.Summary: Represents an exception that is thrown when an error occurs while sending a response message.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.ServiceCollectionExtensions
files.Summary: Provides extension methods for to register NMS AMQP client services.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.SubscriberOptions
files.Summary: Options used to configure a subscriber to a topic.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.SubscriberTransformerAsync
files.Summary: A delegate that a client can register that will be called each time a subscriber dispatches a message to the client code to allow the client to Transform a received message from one type to another, StreamMessage to TextMessage, ObjectMessage to TextMessage containing XML, etc. This allows a client to create a subscriber that will automatically transform a message to a type that the client is capable of processing or adding additional information to a received message. For messages that do not need to be processed the client should return null from this method, in this case the original message will be dispatched to the client.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.TransactionalCommandException
files.Summary: Represents an exception that is thrown when a transactional command fails during execution.

files.Title: CodersRealm.NmsAmqpClient.UserHandlerException
files.Summary: Represents an exception that is thrown when a user-provided handler throws an exception.
